B.Tech Syllabus ​

This page collects semester-wise B.Tech scheme and syllabus documents. The download links below point to PDFs hosted on the official Jabalpur Engineering College website.

NOTE

Check the document title and scheme year before using a syllabus, as older and modified versions may both be listed.
